# When H1_ROTATION_AXIS is 19 axes and dof_pos is 27 dimensions, how to fix it without masking the mapping error?

> **Current answer:** The repository has been fixed to use 19 degrees of freedom (DoF) for the H1 path, initializing dof_pos from 27 to 19 and aligning the joint name list to 19 entries. The fix should use commits after 0c6fd6f and verify the model's DoF count; custom robots cannot arbitrarily change to 19 without aligning DoF vectors, rotation axes, and joint order.

## Problem and symptoms

- What is the correct dimension for the H1_ROTATION_AXIS and dof_pos when multiplying them?
- RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (19) must match the size of tensor b (27) at non-singleton dimension 1.

## Environment

- LeCAR-Lab/human2humanoid; original script used on 2024-10-05; fixed commit 0c6fd6f2a7c0a3974cc2856db1eabb72896b88cd.

## Priority diagnostics

- The H1_ROTATION_AXIS axis count, the last dimension of dof_pos, and the order of h1_joint_names were all verified outside of torch.cat.

## Possible causes

- The old script had H1_ROTATION_AXIS as 19 axes, but dof_pos was initialized as 27 dimensions.

## Attempts

- Community users linked a temporary modification; the questioner replied that it works; the maintainer then released a formal repository update.

## Effective fixes

- Commit 0c6fd6f updated grad_fit_h1_shape.py to change dof_pos from torch.zeros((1,27)) to torch.zeros((1,19)) and align the H1 joint list to 19 entries.

## Result

- A collaborator confirmed the latest version is fixed and closed the issue; the diff precisely covers the error line.

## Limitations

- 19 is the dimension for the H1 model and this script; it is not a universal constant for all custom robots. Dimension changes must synchronize joint order and rotation axes.
